source.prompt: Early 2000s Y2K aesthetic background art: an iridescent holographic pastel gradient of baby pink, lilac and baby blue, glossy 3D translucent butterflies, sparkles, lens flares, shiny chrome stars and soap bubbles floating, dreamy glitter, clean empty area across the middle of the image.

Y2K product-style render of a generic unbranded translucent bubblegum pink flip phone, open, its blank glowing screen, decorated with rhinestone stickers and a beaded charm strap, floating on a glossy hot pink and silver background with chrome stars and sparkles, early 2000s magazine aesthetic, the phone in the lower two thirds.

Dreamy early 2000s computer desktop wallpaper aesthetic: glossy aqua blue liquid swooshes and translucent glass bubbles, soft cyan and white light rays, a chunky translucent blue CRT computer monitor with a blank glowing screen floating among clouds, frutiger aero style, clean and optimistic, empty area at the bottom.

Y2K glamour poster art: a large shiny liquid-chrome butterfly with rhinestone wings on a hot pink and purple glitter background, smaller pink butterflies, star-shaped sparkles, glossy hearts, early 2000s pop aesthetic, butterfly centered in the lower two thirds, empty top.

Y2K cyber aesthetic poster art: a glossy liquid-chrome heart with feathered chrome angel wings, surrounded by sharp tribal-style chrome swirls and star shapes, on a deep black and electric blue gradient background with digital grid lines, reflective metallic render, centered, empty top area.

Flat lay photo from the early 2000s: a blank iridescent recordable CD disc, a closed clear purple translucent portable CD player with its lid shut and plain headphones, glitter gel pens, holographic star stickers and a beaded bracelet scattered on a fuzzy lilac surface, soft flash photography, nostalgic, the disc large in the center.

16-bit pixel art in the style of a 1990s console racing game box art: a small boxy turquoise hatchback with round headlights bouncing along a winding desert canyon road at dusk, giant glowing starfruit-shaped yellow stars in a magenta and orange sky, mesas, cacti, chunky visible pixels, limited palette, dithering, the bottom third of the image is darker road.

8-bit NES-era pixel art: a fantasy stone castle on a hill at night, glowing lantern windows, a winding path, a big full moon, starry navy sky, pine trees, chunky visible square pixels, very limited palette, crisp edges, the top third of the image is empty night sky.

16-bit pixel art of an arcade space shooter: a small chunky orange and white delivery spaceship flying upward through a field of tumbling asteroids and glowing comets, a ringed planet below, deep purple starfield, visible pixels, limited palette, dithering, vertical arcade game style.

16-bit RPG overworld map pixel art seen from above: a lush green island shaped like a sleeping turtle in a turquoise sea, tiny villages, a forest, a volcano, a winding river, a small sailing ship, a lighthouse, chunky visible pixels, limited 1990s console palette, the top band of the image is open sea.

Pixel art interior of a 1980s arcade at night: rows of generic unbranded arcade cabinets with glowing blank colorful screens, a checkered carpet, neon light strips in pink and cyan, deep shadows, chunky visible pixels, limited palette, the bottom quarter is dark carpet.

16-bit platformer game pixel art: floating grassy sky islands and fluffy clouds at sunset, a glowing kite drifting between them, golden coins in arcs, a pastel orange and pink sky, parallax hills far below, chunky visible pixels, limited palette, the top third is open sky.

2000s Japanese anime background art, cel-shaded and hand-painted: city rooftops at golden hour with water tanks, antennas and tangled power lines silhouetted against a huge orange and violet sunset sky with towering cumulus clouds, a flock of birds, no people, painterly, nostalgic, highly detailed.

2000s anime background art, cel-shaded: an empty countryside railroad crossing with its warning lights and striped barrier, rice fields and green hills, telephone poles, a vast blue summer sky with tall white cumulus clouds turning pink at sunset, no people, nostalgic, painterly, high detail.

2000s anime background art, cel-shaded and hand-painted, wide view: a grassy riverbank at sunset with a bicycle leaning against a railing, a long bridge, a city skyline in the distance, the river reflecting a peach and lavender sky, dragonflies, no people, nostalgic, painterly.

2000s anime background art, cel-shaded: a small corner convenience store glowing warmly at dusk on a quiet street, unbranded blank signs, a row of vending machines with glowing blank panels, a bicycle parked outside, power lines, a deep purple and orange twilight sky, no people, nostalgic, painterly.

2000s anime background art, cel-shaded: an empty school classroom at sunset, rows of wooden desks and chairs, golden light pouring through tall windows and long shadows, curtains moving in the breeze, a blank chalkboard, dust in the light, no people, nostalgic, painterly.

2000s anime background art, cel-shaded: a hilly seaside town with stone steps winding down between houses with tiled roofs, overhead power lines, a calm ocean at sunset below, warm pink and gold sky, a small harbor, no people, nostalgic, painterly, high detail.
